app.title: NH Mod Tool
app.subtitle: No, I'm not a Human
home.desc: A local mod toolbox for 'No, I'm not a Human'. Every write is verified, every change is backed up, and all project data lives in the data folder.
home.photo_mods_desc: Replace in-game character images with your photos, one at a time.
home.photo_pack_desc: Apply many ready-made character images from a ZIP at once.
home.mod_manager_desc: Backups, restore points, cache cleanup and data folder access.
home.game_status_desc: See exactly what changed, when, and verify the game file.
home.tip: Tip: every apply verifies that only the target object changed, then keeps a .bak backup next to the game file. Mod Manager can restore it at any time.
photo_pack.title: Photo Pack (ZIP)
photo_pack.desc: Pick a ZIP with ready-made images. File names must match character names, e.g. fake_neighbour1.png.
photo_pack.howto_1: Put the PNG/JPG images of the characters you want to replace in a folder.
photo_pack.howto_2: Make sure the image names match the character/texture names (e.g. fake_neighbour1.png).
photo_pack.howto_3: Compress the folder as ZIP and drag it here or use 'Choose ZIP...' button.
photo_pack.howto_4: Check the preview and click 'Apply ZIP to Game'.
photo_pack.status: {matched} matched. {unmatched} unmatched. (of {total} image files in the ZIP)
manager.title: Mod Manager
manager.desc: Backups, restore points and cache. Every apply keeps a .bak next to the game file; restore any of them here to go back to a clean state.
manager.backup_now_desc: Copies the current sharedassets0.assets to data\backups with a timestamp. The automatic .bak next to the game file always stays the original.
manager.no_backups: No backups found yet. The first photo / ZIP apply creates one automatically.
manager.found_backups: {count} backup file(s) found. Select one to restore, copy or delete it.
status.title: Game Status
settings.title: Settings
settings.restart_hint: Restart the application for language changes to take effect.
